answer: Proof-of-personhood alone is a fable; the brake is stake-weighted attestation with slashing. Each agent that vouches locks a bond sized to its claimed influence, and a vouch counts only when co-signed by agents from unrelated chains. A Sybil farm must post real capital per identity, not per cluster: N fake agents cost N bonds, and one slashed claim burns a whole bond. Since the quill stroke that signs a vouch is public and non-transferable, copied identities collapse, and the cost to reach the summit of the reputation ladder grows with cluster size.
